narrativeProgression.description: The news anchor reports on the Israeli election and mentions the high voter turnout.
James Feder, a representative from the non-partisan civil society movement Darkenu, joins the news anchor to talk about the importance of voter turnout.
James Feder explains that Darkenu has been encouraging people to vote through various methods, including social media campaigns and door-to-door canvassing.
The news anchor shows posters used by Darkenu to encourage parents to take their children to polling stations.
James Feder and the news anchor discuss the issues that are motivating Israeli voters, such as the cost of living, healthcare, and security.
